name: Harvy Jensen

known.fact: Danish civilian hired as Gestapo interpreter 36 hours before Langå.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)

known.fact: Not a torturer. A listener. Friendly, brilliant at reading people; asks teenagers about their families and their clubs, tells each one the last one has already confessed. Breaks the Randers groups in 48 hours. His work leads to 18 executions.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)

known.fact: Later warns the resistance of coming raids. Sentenced to 18 years, out in 1950.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)

known.fact: Røjel called him a traitor for 27 years, read the file in 2000, and wasn't sure.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)

notes: Not the same man as "Jacob" Jensen (SOE agent, Aarhus). Straarup credits Harvy with the Langå round-up.
